sv.title: EU-kommissionen utsatt för cyberattack
sv.summary: EU-kommissionen har drabbats av en cyberattack och hackare kan ha kommit över medarbetares personliga uppgifter, skriver Politico.

en.title: EU Commission hit by cyberattack
en.summary: The EU Commission has been hit by a cyberattack, and hackers may have obtained employees' personal data, Politico reports.
